title: Prediction Uncertainty Controlled Computer Model Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2610.31163v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Computer-model calibration is usually undertaken in service of prediction, yet neither Bayesian Kennedy-O'Hagan (KOH) calibration nor amortized simulation-based inference is built to control the predictive error of the calibrated simulator. When parameters are weakly identified or the data-model discrepancy is misspecified, the simulator-output bands induced by a nominal posterior level can be far from nominal. We propose a two-layer framework that targets predictive miscoverage directly. First, a conditional flow-matching model learns an amortized posterior for the calibration parameters, trained on simulator outputs perturbed with Gaussian-process discrepancies of varying structure. Second, conformal risk control arranges posterior draws for the target observation into nested candidate sets and selects the smallest one whose fixed-rank pointwise bands attain a prescribed time-averaged miscoverage on a synthetic calibration sample. translated_title: 预测不确定性可控的计算机模型校准
translated_abstract: 计算机模型校准通常是为预测服务的，然而无论是贝叶斯Kennedy-O'Hagan (KOH)校准还是摊销式的基于模拟的推断，其设计目的都不是控制校准后模拟器的预测误差。当参数识别性较弱或数据-模型差异被错误设定时，由名义后验水平导出的模拟器输出区间可能远偏离名义覆盖水平。我们提出了一个直接针对预测覆盖不足（miscoverage）的两层框架。第一层中，一个条件流匹配模型学习校准参数的摊销式后验，其训练数据是由不同结构的高斯过程差异扰动后的模拟器输出。第二层中，共形风险控制将针对目标观测的后验样本组织成嵌套的候选集合，并选出其中最小的集合，使其固定秩的逐点预测区间在合成校准样本上达到规定的时间平均覆盖不足率。
tldr: 该论文提出一个两层框架，将条件流匹配摊销后验推断与共形风险控制相结合，直接控制校准后模拟器的预测覆盖率，即使在校准参数弱识别或模型差异被误设的情况下也能保证名义的预测区间水平。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-layer framework combining conditional flow-matching amortized posterior inference with conformal risk control to directly control the predictive miscoverage of calibrated computer simulators, ensuring nominal coverage even under weak parameter identifiability or misspecified model discrepancy.
